correctness.rationale: Balance of the four-state binary de Bruijn graph yields a unique nonnegative parameterization (a,h,t,u,j). Exactly five nonoverlapping connected-support cases are exhaustive; directed Euler-circuit sufficiency and summing their positive integer generators prove the GF for every \(n\geq1\), including periodic and \(n<3\) cases. Explicit singularity analysis gives leading \(n^4/288\). The standard-library checker directly compares full histogram vector sets for n=1..16 and parameter sums at n=20,24,30. Limits: no fiber-size theorem; finite checks are not proofs.

value.rationale: Counts exactly the attainable outputs of a natural cyclic substring-histogram channel, hence determines the maximum size of a zero-error reconstruction code from its output for every blocklength. First collision at n=6 separates this statistic from ordinary necklace enumeration; sharp order and leading constant quantify observation resolution. This is an intrinsic natural exact capacity fact rather than an arbitrary small numerical slice.
